Use the assumptions and notation of Claim 5.3.1.

\[
\mathbf M(Y)\ge \rho_\eta(y)S_1S_2.
\]
fixed_proof:
By Stokes’ theorem for currents,
\[
Y(d\alpha_\eta)=\rho_\eta(y)S_1S_2.
\]
Since \(d\alpha_\eta=d\rho_\eta\wedge dx_1\wedge dx_2\) has comass at most \(1\), the mass of \(Y\) is at least \(\rho_\eta(y)S_1S_2\).
